title: Son Murders Mom and Her Fiancé at Florida RV Park
description:
Police respond to a Manatee County, Florida RV park after Thomas Matejcek allegedly attacked his mother, Patty, and her fiancé, Sean Harrison. Bodycam captures the chaotic scene, investigation, and Thomas's bizarre interrogation before he's charged with two counts of first-degree murder.
